title: Meal plan and groceries
audience: For households tired of deciding what's for dinner at 6 pm.
description: A week of dinners that writes its own grocery list, by aisle, minus what's in the cupboard. Plan it in the app, or tell your AI what you feel like.
tagline: Dinners for the week and what to buy.
seoTitle: Meal plan and grocery list template for ChatGPT
note:
Meal plan and groceries

Plan the week's dinners in the app and the grocery list builds itself: by aisle, things two dinners share on one line, and nothing you always have at home. Or tell your AI what you feel like and it plans both.

## Dinners to try
Dishes you'd like to cook some week, one line each.

prompt.default: Use my Pinto Notes note "Meal plan and groceries". It is an app; its data is "Meal plan and groceries.app/data.json", beside the note. Read it with fetch before each change; change it with edit. Ask which nights we cook, who cooks and what to skip. Add each dinner to values.dinners as { id, date (yyyy-mm-dd), dish, cook, ingredients: [{ name, qty, aisle }] }, aisle one of values.aisles; a recipe note's path goes in recipe, a new cook in values.cooks. The app builds the grocery list from the ingredients, less values.cupboard. Anything else to buy goes in values.extras as { id, week (its Monday), name, qty, aisle }. Keep earlier weeks.

asks: Ask which nights we're cooking and what to skip, then plan this week's dinners and the groceries.
Plan dinners for this week, Oskar cooks Tuesday and Thursday.
Add oat milk and lemons to this week's groceries.

args.old_string: Dishes you'd like to cook some week, one line each.
args.new_string:
Dishes you'd like to cook some week, one line each.
- Miso salmon with greens
- Shakshuka for a slow Sunday
- Maja's red lentil soup
